policy.production_rule: Only a resource with an explicit reusable licence and approved source record may be imported with usage_scope=production.
policy.tier_2_rule: Registration is allowed, but production import requires recorded pharmacist/legal approval.
policy.tier_3_rule: Reference or isolated demo use only; never merge into production catalog data.

nppa-antidiabetes-formulations-2026-03.scope_note: Approval covers only the 11 NPPA-authored formulation records in the pinned package. It does not approve inferred brands, manufacturers, regimens, substitutions, or third-party fields.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform India resources licensed under GODL-India
sources.operator: National Informatics Centre, MeitY, Government of India
sources.automated_collection: Use only the download/API declared on the individual resource; do not assume every linked resource is GODL.
sources.catalog_fit: No nationwide brand-product master suitable for indoro was located as of the access date.

sources.name: CDSCO approved new drugs and fixed-dose combinations
sources.automated_collection: No stable bulk API located; PDF and dynamic-search ingestion needs written approval and version pinning.
sources.catalog_fit: Useful approval evidence and formulation overlay, not a complete marketed-brand catalog.

sources.name: National List of Essential Medicines 2022
sources.operator: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.automated_collection: Do not bulk-import into production until reuse permission or a GODL-published resource is confirmed.
sources.catalog_fit: Strong ingredient, strength and dosage-form backbone; no nationwide brand/manufacturer/package master.

sources.name: NPPA ceiling and retail price orders
sources.automated_collection: Import only NPPA-authored fields covered by its copyright policy; isolate third-party market or manufacturer data.
sources.catalog_fit: Useful formulation/unit and price-order facts, not a comprehensive autocomplete master.

sources.name: Jan Aushadhi product MRP list
sources.operator: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India
sources.automated_collection: Do not call undocumented application endpoints for catalog harvesting; obtain a sanctioned file/API and permission.
sources.catalog_fit: Promising generic product code, description, pack and price source after written permission.

sources.name: PvPI drug safety alerts
sources.automated_collection: Human-reviewed safety overlay only; never infer a product-wide contraindication from an ingredient alert.
sources.catalog_fit: Safety monitoring overlay, not identification or autocomplete data.

sources.name: Indian Pharmacopoeia Online
sources.automated_collection: No automated extraction or data mining.
sources.catalog_fit: Standards reference only under an appropriate subscription/licence.

sources.name: Commercial pharmacy websites (1mg, PharmEasy, Netmeds, Apollo and similar)
sources.automated_collection: No scraping or bulk copying without an explicit licence or data-supply agreement.

sources.name: indoro synthetic medicine identification fixtures
sources.automated_collection: Local synthetic demo import only; no external collection.
sources.catalog_fit: Autocomplete and regression demonstration across form, route, release, alias and long-name cases. Never promote automatically.

sources.name: Legacy commercial-site-derived prototype seed
